title: Pausing a Godot world for three LLM decisions, then replaying the accepted controls
author: ViceGodIm
selftext:
For my new escape-room experiment, I freeze the simulation while Gemini, Qwen and Nemotron choose their next controls. All three use the same world snapshot, then Godot advances three game seconds.



Inputs are structured text state, recent public radio messages and legal button labels. The engine handles routes and physics. I save requests, accepted replies and replay frames so camera changes don't need another API run.



The screenshot shows a radio message alongside the button actually selected. Keeping them separate makes it possible to check whether an offer to rescue another player becomes an action.



My 2:27 film: [https://youtu.be/ej0GjJyqq2c](https://youtu.be/ej0GjJyqq2c)



There's an earlier run with a blocking collision bug and a fresh attempt after fixing it. Some settings changed too; this isn't a controlled comparison of the models.
